verdict.rationale: Gmail supports 'delegate' access, letting multiple people read, send, and delete mail from one account, which approximates a shared inbox with a single conversation state (gmail-docs-11, gmail-docs-19). However, this is a basic delegation feature—there's no evidence of true team-inbox tooling like conversation assignment, internal notes, read/unread sync across delegates, or dedicated shared-channel UI, and community feedback highlights sync/notification limitations in Gmail's underlying protocols (gmail-comm-1, gmail-comm-2). Missing for 10: dedicated shared-inbox UI with assignment/ownership, real-time synced read-state across all delegate users, internal team notes/threads, and any documented scale beyond a handful of delegates.
